introduction: Most of us regret doing things - or not doing things - in the past, and you can use the English word

vocabulary.definition: a feeling of sadness or disappointment about something that has happened or that you have done
vocabulary.example: She regrets not studying harder for the exam.

vocabulary.definition: something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected
vocabulary.example: I found a great bargain at the thrift store.

vocabulary.definition: relating to grammar or the rules of grammar
vocabulary.example: She is a stickler for correct grammatical usage.

vocabulary.definition: expressing denial or refusal, or a disadvantage or criticism
vocabulary.example: He received negative feedback on his performance.

vocabulary.definition: feeling sad, unhappy, or displeased because something was not as good as expected or because something you hoped for did not happen
vocabulary.example: She was disappointed with the results of the experiment.

vocabulary.definition: to understand or become aware of a particular fact or situation
vocabulary.example: I didn't realize how late it was until I saw the time.
